results.description: Monocular relative depth estimation

images.title: Images
images.description: Input images, accepts JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP files

to_base64.title: To Base64
to_base64.description: Whether to return the arrays in JSON files as base64 strings with shape and dtype.

num_patches.title: Num Patches
num_patches.description: The maximum spatial dimension of input tensor defined in number of patches. The patch dimension is 14 px. Only used if processing_resolution is set to 'custom'.

return_depth.title: Return Depth
return_depth.description: Whether to return depth images or not.

output_format.description: Output format of the prediction results.

keys_to_exclude.title: Keys To Exclude
keys_to_exclude.description: Comma-separated list of keys to exclude from the output JSON files.

alpha_blend_onto.description: Blend mode for images with alpha channels. The 'mean' mode blends the image onto ImageNet mean RGB values. The 'keep' mode keeps the original pixel values.

processing_resolution.description: Maximum spatial dimension of input tensor passed to the model. The 'default' is 504 px, 36 patches 14 x 14 px. For the 'match_input' option, the dimension will be computed across th batch. The 'custom' option allows to set the spatial dimension manually via the num_patches parameter.

PredictorOutput.title: PredictorOutput
PredictorOutput.description:
Class defining structure of the output.

Attributes:
    depth_images (Optional[list[Path]]): List of paths to depth images.
    data (list[Path]): List of paths to the NPZ/JSON files containing the prediction results.
